secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Resend API key for emailing signup verification codes. Without it, codes print to the server console and signup still works. Get it from https://resend.com/api-keys.

secrets.name: STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Stripe secret key to create real Checkout sessions for card/ACH payment setup. Without it, the payment step honestly reports no processor is connected. Get it from https://dashboard.stripe.com/apikeys.
